title: Exact derived normalization of the ProEtale comparison path
statement: For every commutative ring, chosen Cartesian square and bounded-below input, the ProEtale derived path equals the exact derived image of comparisonSquareProEtalePath, precomposed with comparisonSquareSourceIso.inv and postcomposed with comparisonSquareTargetIso.hom. These paths and endpoint factors are the explicit constructions of [stage3-proetale-comparison-square-paths]. This asserts only one path identification; it assumes and concludes no square coherence. The square is supplied by an IsPullback proof. The assertion is HEq between the derived ordinary path composite and the stated component path, retaining their definitionally equal endpoint presentations to avoid expensive kernel conversion.

proof.text: Expand comparisonSquareProEtalePath as the two whiskered edge comparisons at f-prime and g, followed by the ordinary pro-etale square whiskered by the comparison pullback. Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_trans and the two whiskering equations; mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_assoc collects the endpoint composition factors into comparisonSquareSourceIso and the exact part of comparisonSquareTargetIso. The internal composition factors cancel.

Expand leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso at f-prime and g, using the definitional equality between comparisonCoefficientPullbackIso and comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso.symm. Naturality of the inverse exactness comparison for f-prime turns the two displayed edge arrows into the exact derived edge path followed by the inverse exactness factors at g and f-prime.

Expand leftDerivedUpperStarSquareIso, leftDerivedFunctorNatIso and leftDerivedFunctorCompIso. The composite-functor exactness factors cancel, leaving the exact derived composition maps conjugated by the individual exactness factors. Equality induction for leftDerivedUpperStarCongr identifies the commutativity transport with that of proEtaleComparisonSquare. The factors at g and f-prime cancel those from the edge path; the surviving inverse factors at f and g-prime are exactly comparisonSquareTargetIso. Associate and evaluate at M.obj. The bounded-below compatibility on the source edges is the identity. No etale square identity or underived coherence is used.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Canonical exact derived composition comparison; no specialized site-path normalization.

mathlib_searches.query: An exact functor induces a functor on derived categories preserving composition and natural isomorphisms
mathlib_searches.verdict: General exact derivation and localization factors are available.
The coherence identities needed to normalize each ordinary path are proved.

mathlib_searches.query: An equality of natural isomorphisms of exact functors induces an equality on derived categories
mathlib_searches.verdict: General derivation of isomorphisms and congruence found; no specialized comparison-square path normalization.

theorem comparisonSquareProEtalePath_normalization
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    HEq
      (comparisonSquareDerivedPath Λ g' f' f g (comparisonSquareProEtalePath Λ
        { toCommSq := sq.toCommSq, isoPullback := sq.isoPullback,
          hom_fst := sq.isoPullback_hom_fst, hom_snd := sq.isoPullback_hom_snd }) M)
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso f' Λ).hom.app
            (D+(Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj M) ≫
          L(ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').map
            ((leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso g Λ).hom.app M) ≫
          (leftDerivedUpperStarSquareIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).hom.app
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ D(ν^*(Y)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).obj M))
